numerical.evaluation: All eight tokens are training examples; no held-out accuracy claim.

range_proof.contract: Public bound across all 8 one-hot inputs; no private domain check.

isolated_replay.model_preparation_contract: Fresh model-dependent A/F correlations are prepared separately for each query; model sharing may be reused, correlations cannot
isolated_replay.ideal_timing_kind: sum of per-phase maxima of independent-role median samples
isolated_replay.timing_boundary: Resident secret inputs/model through every intermediate and final MAC check; native preprocessing, recurring per-query model-dependent preparation and private sharing excluded

fp32_graph.measurement: CUDA events around CPU-issued graph replays; includes any GPU starvation between submissions

clear_baselines.model: actual trained Linear(8,2), square, Linear(2,8) in PyTorch inference mode

measurement: Four real processes over localhost mutual TLS; shared GPU and OS account. Live inference includes first-use compilation and optional transcript recording; it is not a steady-state or ideal-network estimate. Optional isolated_replay serializes each role after a completion barrier and reports separate perfect-network estimates.
provisioning: Each worker consumes only its own native role bundle. No coordinator reads private preprocessing. Deployment needs separate security domains.

pipeline_cost.formula: crypto_batch_ms / distinct_single_use_query_packs + fresh_model_preparation_ms + new_input_sharing_ms + checked_query_ms + static_model_sharing_ms / model_queries
pipeline_cost.reuse_contract: Each query consumes its own fresh correlations and E/F preparation; only static model sharing is reusable.
pipeline_cost.timing_context: Native generation and cold preparation/sharing stages plus isolated query estimate when requested; no correlation reuse or extrapolated batching throughput.
